fact: The Vote Budget Framework Paper for Vote 020 Ministry of ICT and National Guidance gives an approved FY2025/26 GoU total of UGX 105.963 billion and a proposed FY2026/27 budget of UGX 104.657 billion.
title: Vote Budget Framework Paper FY2026/27, Vote 020 Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
